messages:
priya: Heads-up — planning a small canary for the new image trust-anchor and KMS envelope key rotation. Need to align RBAC changes & audit fields before cutover.
ashley: +1. What's the minimal RBAC delta for the image-signer service account?
devin: image-signer only needs kms:Encrypt/Decrypt on the signing-key and storage:GetObject for the signed artifacts. We should avoid broad iam.serviceAccounts.* perms.
tal: Agreed. Proposed role JSON: 
```json
{
  "name": "roles/redwood.imageSigner",
  "permissions": ["cloudkms.cryptoSign", "cloudkms.getPublicKey", "storage.objects.get"]
}
```
priya: That looks good. Two questions: 1) audit log schema — we need a stable JSON envelope for forensic queries. 2) during canary, how do we surface failed attestations to ops?
ashley: For audit logs I'd like a compact envelope: timestamp, actor, artifact_sha, key_id, action, result, error_code, meta. Example entry we discussed: 
```json
{
  "ts": "2026-03-19T18:12:03Z",
  "actor": "sa:image-signer@redwood-prod",
  "artifact_sha": "sha256:abcd...",
  "key_id": "projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/signing-key/cryptoKeyVersions/1",
  "action": "cosign.sign",
  "result": "ok",
  "meta": { "duration_ms": 120 }
}
```
devin: +1 on that schema. Also include a truncated signature prefix to speed searches (first 12 chars).
ops-bot: Incident policy reminder: any canary failures with >5% attestation error rate across 1 minute window will auto-create an incident and notify #incidents and on-call.
priya: Good to know — we'll set alerting threshold to 3% for the first 30min so we can detect regressions faster but avoid noisy paging.
tal: One more: KMS key rotation plan. We'll use envelope keys (customer-managed) in KMS and cosign with KMS-backed key. During rotation, the old key must remain available for verification. How are we storing key metadata?
ashley: Store key metadata in the signing-manifest service with these fields: key_uri, version, active_from, prev_versions (list), fingerprint. Manifest is write-restricted to ops + sec rotation service.
priya: OK. For RBAC rollout plan: 1) create roles/redwood.imageSigner (dev/staging), 2) bind to canary SA only, 3) run smoke-sign tests, 4) promote role to prod and bind to prod signer SA.
devin: For vuln triage: one of the base layers flagged a CVE-2026-1023 (openssl minor). We'll rebuild canary images with patched base and run full attestation flow. If signature step fails, we need a fallback: sign with a compatible local ephemeral key and flag artifacts as "temporary-signed" in meta.
priya: That's a good fallback — ensure the ephemeral key is rotated hourly and the fallback signatures are clearly discoverable in audit logs.
sec-bot: Security check: policy change detected on roles/redwood.imageSigner in sandbox at 2468509850 by ashley. Diff: removed storage.objects.list permission.
ashley: That was intentional. Will push same to staging.
ops-bot: Canary deploy started (canary-3) on cluster eu-west-1a, 10% traffic. Link: https://console.redwood.internal/canaries/24685
devin: Running verify script now: `scripts/verify-signing.sh --canary canary-3`
priya: If we see >1% attestation failures, pause rollout and collect logs: cosign stderr, KMS audit entries, runtime liveness. I'll be on standby.
tal: After successful canary, add a post-cutover job to prune old key versions older than 90 days from manifest (but not from KMS).
ashley: Noted. Also will open a short runbook for on-call detailing rollback steps (rebind old signer SA + re-sign existing artifacts if necessary).
priya: Perfect. Thanks everyone — will follow up with the role JSON PR and the audit schema PR.
ops-bot: Canary metrics: 10% traffic, attestation errors 0.6% (2/320), latency +8ms median. No incident opened.
priya: Closing the loop — created PRs: roles PR #4237, audit-schema PR #4238, runbook draft linked in docs. Will run the staged rollout tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
sec-bot: Reminder: after rollout, run the audit-query smoke to ensure logs are indexed in ELK within 60s.
